--> Conseil :
Si vous pensez avoir une seule structure dans le modèle, cela peut provenir de noeud(s) orphelin(s). Dans ce cas, vérifiez le maillage.

Caution: more than six modes of rigid body were detected. 
 
--> Advices: 
If you think of having only one structure in the model, that can come from node (S) orphan (S). In this case, check the mesh.
